entrypoints.add: stdin-key | scripts/agentkey.py add NAME --provider P [--expires ISO] [--key-file 0600-PATH]

exit_codes.3: cipher/passphrase unavailable (openssl missing or no pass)
exit_codes.4: integrity failure (wrong passphrase or tampered vault/audit)

policy.key_input: stdin or --key-file (mode 600 enforced) only — argv refused by design
policy.pass_input: AGENTKEY_PASS, --pass-file (mode 600 enforced), or tty getpass; empty refused
policy.crypto: AES-256-CBC PBKDF2-SHA256 600k iters (openssl enc), HMAC-SHA256 Encrypt-then-MAC, tag verified before decrypt
